odia: କଅଁଳକହୀ ରାଧା, ଘରକୁ ଗଲେ କଥା ନ କହନ୍ତି ବାଟରେ ବଡ଼ ଶରଧା
title: Warm words on the road
literal_meaning: Sweet-speaking Radha: when one goes to the house, she does not speak; on the road, such affection.
explanation: The praise in “sweet-speaking” is undercut by the change of setting. On the road there is a warm reception; at the house there is not even conversation. The linked dictionary definition includes flattering words that conceal a different intention, so the contrast is sharper than a simple difference between a busy and a free moment. The line can tease or reproach warmth that seems to depend on where it is displayed. It does not tell us who visits the house or what relationship the visitor has to Radha. Our present-day application concerns inconsistent welcome, not a rule about women or a story about a deity.
meaning_odia: ବାଟରେ ଦେଖାହେଲେ ଏତେ ଶରଧା, ଘରକୁ ଗଲେ ପଦେ କଥା ନାହିଁ—ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳିବା ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ଆଚରଣ ବଦଳିଯାଉଛି। ଏହି ଓଲଟା ଦେଖାଇ “କଅଁଳକହୀ” ପ୍ରଶଂସାଟି କଟାକ୍ଷ ହୋଇଯାଏ। ସଂଯୁକ୍ତ ଅଭିଧାନ ଶବ୍ଦରେ ମନରେ କପଟ ରଖି ମିଠା କଥା କହିବାର ଅର୍ଥ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛି। ଦେଖାସାକ୍ଷାତରେ ଆଦର ଦେଖାଇ ପାଖକୁ ଆସିଲେ ମୁହଁ ଫେରାଇବାକୁ ଏହି କଥାରେ ଧରିହୁଏ। କିଏ ଘରକୁ ଗଲେ ବା ରାଧାଙ୍କ ସହ ତାଙ୍କର କି ସମ୍ପର୍କ, ପଦଟି ସେ କଥା କହେନାହିଁ।
english_summary: A warm greeting in one setting rings hollow when it turns into silence in another.
odia_summary: ବାଟର ଆଦର ଘରେ ନିରବତା ହେଲେ ମିଠା କଥାର ଅସଙ୍ଗତି ଧରାପଡ଼େ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: A neighbour repeatedly welcomes someone warmly at the market and invites them to drop by. When the visitor arrives at the agreed time, the neighbour will not acknowledge them. Later, the visitor quotes the saying to a friend with a rueful laugh. This invented scene illustrates the contrast; it is not the source’s occasion.
cultural_context: Radha is the name in the wording; no mythological identity, romance or biography is established. 8859 is lexical context only, not another full-saying witness. The visitor and relationship remain unspecified. Teasing force follows the source contrast and linked flattering-speech definition; contemporary situation is editorial.
